cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), Mum, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa, Lily's classmate Mia, cousin Sam (10) and the puppy Max. Places that help people in town.

words.en: We eat dinner in a restaurant.
words.scene: the family eating dinner in a restaurant, a waiter bringing plates
more: Dad orders fish at the restaurant.
The food in this restaurant is good.
这家餐馆的食物很好吃。

words.en: Aunt Kate works in a bank.
words.scene: a big stone bank building with columns, people going in
more: Mum goes to the bank today.
The bank is open on Monday.

words.en: We drink tea in the cafe.
more: Lily eats a cake at the cafe.
The cafe is near our house.

words.en: We have lunch in the cafeteria.
more: Tom eats an apple in the cafeteria.

words.en: We watch a film at the cinema.
words.scene: Lily and Tom with popcorn in a dark cinema watching the big screen
more: Let's go to the cinema on Sunday.
我们星期日去电影院吧。

words.scene: Lily sitting in a big green dentist's chair with her mouth open, a smiling grown-up dentist in a white coat leaning over her with a small mirror, Mum standing behind the chair.
more: Mum is at the dentist's office.

words.scene: A kind grown-up man doctor in a white coat sitting at his desk, listening to Tom's chest with a stethoscope, Tom sitting on a high chair with his eyes wide, Mum beside him.
more: Mum is a nurse, not a doctor.
Go to the doctor if you are ill.

words.en: Dad parks the car in the garage.
more: The bikes are in the garage.
Max sleeps in the garage sometimes.

words.scene: A big hotel with a doorman and taxis outside.

words.en: Lily reads books in the library.
more: We borrow books from the library.

words.en: We see old things in the museum.
words.sz: 我们在博物馆看古老的东西。
words.scene: Lily and Tom looking up at a big dinosaur model in a museum hall, a kind guide smiling beside them, tall windows and stone steps behind.
more: The museum is free for children.

words.en: Dad stops at the petrol station.
words.scene: A petrol station at the side of a road, Dad standing beside the family car filling it with petrol from a green pump, a small shop behind.
more: The petrol station is on the corner.
We buy drinks at the petrol station.

words.en: Lily sends a card at the post office.
words.scene: Lily posting a parcel at the post office counter
more: The post office is near school.
We buy stamps at the post office.

words.en: We play games at the sports centre.
words.sz: 我们在体育中心玩游戏。
more: Tom goes to the sports centre on Saturday.
Tom 星期六去体育中心。

words.en: Lily swims in the swimming pool.
more: The water in the swimming pool is blue.
游泳池里的水是蓝色的。
We go to the swimming pool in summer.

words.en: We watch a play at the theatre.
words.scene: a theatre stage with red curtains, the family in their seats
more: Grandma loves going to the theatre.
